modules.description: Language-agnostic workflow rules: agents orchestration, code review standards, coding style, development workflow, git, hooks, patterns, performance, security, and testing.
Go-specific coding style, hooks, patterns, security, and testing rules. Applied only to *.go and go.mod files.
Python-specific coding style, patterns, security, and testing rules. Applied only to *.py files.

GG specialist agents: planner, architect, tdd-guide, go-reviewer, go-build-resolver, python-reviewer, build-error-resolver, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, doc-updater, database-reviewer, plus frontend/design agents (a11y-architect, gan-planner, gan-generator, gan-evaluator), and more.

All /gg: slash commands: /gg:plan, /gg:tdd, /gg:build-fix, /gg:review, /gg:ship, /gg:harness-audit, /gg:security-scan, /gg:update-docs, /gg:learn, /gg:gan-build, /gg:gan-design, and more, plus command runtime scripts.

Hook runtime for GG default guard hooks (compact reminders, quality gate, config protection, GateGuard) plus skill lifecycle dispatch (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd). Installs scripts to ~/.claude/plugins/gg/ and merges hook entries into ~/.claude/settings.json.

Core workflow skills: using-gg (routing), plan-orchestrate (agent chains), iterative-retrieval (subagent context handoff), tdd-workflow (RED-GREEN-REFACTOR), verification-loop (quality gates), gg-guide (navigation), search-first, terminal-ops, strategic-compact (manual context compaction), workspace-surface-audit, context-budget (token-overhead audit), agent-introspection-debugging (4-phase agent self-debug).
Go engineering skills: golang-patterns (idiomatic Go, concurrency, error handling) and golang-testing (table-driven tests, benchmarks, fuzzing, TDD).
Python engineering skills: python-patterns (Pythonic idioms, PEP 8, type hints) and python-testing (pytest, TDD, fixtures, mocking, parametrization, coverage).
Database skills: safe schema/data migrations and rollback (database-migrations), PostgreSQL query and schema patterns (postgres-patterns), MySQL patterns (mysql-patterns).
Security skills: comprehensive review checklist for auth, secrets, API, payments (security-review) and Claude Code configuration security audit via AgentShield (security-scan).

DevOps skills: CI/CD pipeline and deployment workflows (deployment-patterns), Docker and Docker Compose patterns (docker-patterns), Git branching and commit conventions (git-workflow), GitHub PR and CI management (github-ops).
Autonomous loop patterns: sequential pipelines, NanoClaw REPL, infinite agentic loops, continuous PR loops, Ralphinho RFC-driven DAG orchestration.

Continuous learning v2: instinct-based session observation, confidence scoring, project-scoped instincts, and evolution into skills/commands/agents. Requires observer.enabled=true in config.json to run background analysis.

Extended backend engineering skills: api-design, architecture-decision-records, agent-architecture-audit, backend-patterns, codebase-onboarding, coding-standards, documentation-lookup, e2e-testing, error-handling, hexagonal-architecture, mcp-server-patterns, pytorch-patterns, redis-patterns, repo-scan, team-builder.

Optional agent observability and quality-gate skills: enterprise-agent-ops (long-lived agent lifecycle, metrics, incident pattern), eval-harness (eval-driven development with pass@k / pass^k metrics), and task-trace (local JSONL task timelines with tool/file activity). Pair with continuous-learning-v2 to gate /gg:promote on functional evals instead of confidence alone.
Codex adapter skills that route GG command, agent, rule, and MCP playbooks from the same source files used by Claude Code.

RAG knowledge base builder: repo-rag-builder generates .rag/ with layered docs (L0 overview, L1 system, L2 module, L3 chain), OpenAPI contracts, two-level ADR retrieval, and GraphRAG knowledge graph. Pair with /gg:build-rag (full build) and /gg:rag-sync (incremental sync via doc-updater).

Evidence-backed documentation protocols and Codex-native workflows: auditable Claim/Evidence/Verdict/Finding stores, static observation, approval-gated candidate patch application, Blueprint-driven synthesis, transactional publication, runtime-aware maintenance, and deterministic indexing.

Adversarial verification and decision council: santa-method (dual independent reviewer agents with convergence loop — use before shipping production code, migrations, or public APIs) and council (four-voice adversarial decision council for architecture and strategy choices).

Frontend / UI quality skills (ECC-migrated, framework-agnostic): accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA audit + semantic ARIA), design-system (token extraction + visual consistency audit), brand-voice (writing voice profile, plus UX-microcopy adaptation note), ui-demo (Playwright-recorded walkthrough videos), dashboard-builder (operator-oriented Grafana/SigNoz boards for OTel-instrumented projects), frontend-slides (zero-dependency animated HTML presentations), gan-style-harness (Generator/Evaluator design-quality loop). Pairs with agents a11y-architect, gan-planner, gan-generator, gan-evaluator and commands /gg:gan-design, /gg:gan-build.
